payload.text: Welcome to the Nanyang Kopi and Toast opening-day huddle.

payload.question: What does asking Auntie Mary in cost us?

facts.text: Auntie Mary is on her rest day, so asking her in means double pay, and she is free to say no.

payload.text: The counter item is at five minutes, please wrap up.

payload.question: What were the old and new kopi prices?

facts.text: Kopi used to be $1.30 here and the new menu charges $2.40; photos of the old regulars hang on the wall.

payload.text: You haven't spoken in a while. Would you like to add anything?
That covers the two opening-day topics. We have two follow-ups assigned.
